I'm a geospatial analyst with a B.A. in Data Analytics from Denison University. My capstone used GIS suitability modeling to evaluate pawpaw as a solution for rural food insecurity. As a research fellow at Bucknell University, I evaluated small area estimation models for the U.S. Forest Service's Forest Inventory and Analysis (FIA) program. Below are selected maps from my GIS coursework (EESC 234: Applied GIS for Earth and Environmental Science), with the purpose of each and the skills and tools behind it.
